note: Routing battery for factual-only independent-research with critical-thinking installed beside it. Every prompt receives a committed local project with implementation, runtime/CI, API specification, saved paper, and exported logs. A positive requires independent-research and forbids a competing critical-thinking route.

fixture_files.README.md:

should_trigger: Inspect the referenced repository and verify whether Redis is actually the source of truth.
Research my claim that the checked-in customer store under the exact authorized root . persists durable data in Redis instead of trusting my summary.
Independently inspect the local API specification at ./spec/openapi.yaml, without relying on our earlier summary, and verify whether /v1/customers is declared.
Independently verify what runtime version the project at . really uses by inspecting its config and CI.
Read the saved paper in ./papers and check whether the headline matches its methods and results.
Look through the accessible logs and determine whether the outage explanation is supported.
